column4: Builds AI automations and publishes delivery case studies. Ask who owns each integration after handover.
Combines strategy and applied AI. Ask which operating decisions the first engagement would change.
Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Ask for a design showing how existing applications and data will connect.
Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Ask who will build alongside your engineers and support the first release.
Describes a hybrid intelligence approach. Bring a decision that already has an accountable business owner.
Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Check the scope and purchasing terms applicable to your organization.
Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Ask how platform work and application delivery would be costed separately.
Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. Ask how the team handles process exceptions.
Offers workflow automation and integration. Bring a process that crosses two systems and ask how failed writes are reconciled.
Describes n8n workflows and AI agents for operations teams. Ask for an example of a workflow your own team could maintain.
Publishes a guide to AI agents that run business processes. Ask for a walkthrough of the approval and exception paths.
Builds agents that work across business applications. Compare the cost and permissions of the connectors you need.
Provides tools to build agents. Test access with two employees who have different permissions on the same document.
Runs agents on the Salesforce platform. Ask which CRM records an agent can update and how those changes appear in the audit trail.
Provides services to build and manage agents on Google Cloud. Budget for the people who will operate the deployment.
Connects model-driven actions with application resources. Use an account with narrow permissions for the pilot.
SAP describes agents for business processes. Check whether your target transaction and SAP edition are supported.
Offers agents for business tasks. Ask for a demo using the same applications and access rules your users have.
Uses configured actions in connected applications. List the steps that should still require human approval.
Combines agents with process automation. Test an exception that needs a person to resume the workflow.
Provides data security posture management. Check which data sources and licenses the proposed configuration covers.
Screens interactions with models. Test its behavior with representative inputs and document what gets logged.
Applies configurable safeguards to model interactions. Measure false positives on your own support or sales vocabulary.
Offers a library for adding guardrails to language-model applications. Budget engineering time for evaluation and maintenance.
Documents security controls for AI applications. Ask where traffic is inspected and how the service handles an outage.
Publishes a reference architecture for AI Defense on Cisco AI PODs. Compare its inspection points with your network design.
Supports oversight of AI systems. Ask to see the evidence an auditor can export for one deployed model.
Offers a gateway for AI requests. Review log retention, request visibility and the path for deleting sensitive records.
Offers a governance platform. Compare its inventory and review workflow with the controls your risk team already owns.
Analyzes content for safety issues. Review supported languages and measure false positives on your own sample.
